parts.text:
1 Robot Controller
1 Edge Computer

8 Sensoren:
- 2 LiDAR
- 2 Kameras
- 2 Encoder
- 1 IMU
- 1 Abstandssensor

6 Aktoren:
- 4 Motor Drives
- 2 Steering Actuators

Kommunikation:
- LiDAR/Kamera: Ethernet / DDS
- Motor Drives: EtherCAT
- IMU/Encoder: CAN-FD
- Edge ↔ Robot Controller: 1-Gbit Ethernet

Funktionen:
EnvironmentPerception
Localization
MotionControl
SteeringControl
HealthMonitoring
